description:
You are a mobile build engineer maintaining build pipelines. A configuration file in INI format, located at /home/user/build_config.ini, controls the key settings for different build environments. The file includes at least two sections: [development] and [production], each containing a build_version entry.

Your task is as follows:

1. Parse the /home/user/build_config.ini file to retrieve the value of build_version under the [production] section only.
2. Output the retrieved value to a new log file located at /home/user/prod_build_version.log.
3. The output in /home/user/prod_build_version.log must contain only the version value from [production] (no section headers, no labels, no extra lines or whitespace), followed by a single newline.

For example, if the [production] section in /home/user/build_config.ini contains build_version=4.2.5, then /home/user/prod_build_version.log should contain:
4.2.5

Please ensure that the log file is created with the exact format above, as automated tests will verify the contents precisely.
truth:
# Pre-task file:
# /home/user/build_config.ini
# Contents:
[development]
build_version=4.1.0
api_url=https://dev.api.example.com

[production]
build_version=4.2.5
api_url=https://api.example.com

# File to be created by the agent:
/home/user/prod_build_version.log
# Correct contents:
4.2.5
